findings.quote: Ju noggrannare en sträcka hade rensats, desto fler rensningsdagar krävde den, oberoende av hur brant fallet var.
findings.note: PARTIALLY. Options B and C assert the same counterintuitive finding (more thorough clearing -> more clearing days); C is the unrestricted generalisation ('oberoende av hur brant fallet var') while B is scoped to the lowest stretches. The key/overgeneralised-twin pair is visible from form alone, with no domain knowledge, and narrows the field to two (blind pick B). Not decided blind: A and D remain formally possible. Normal distractor design, so flag not kill.

findings.quote: Hur mycket som rensades tycks ha styrts mer av föreningens skyldighet mot markägarna än av timrets värde.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, residual cross-question hint only. DECISIVE CHECK: the q3->q2 leak is REPAIRED - q3 no longer restates the September deadline, so q2's key can no longer be read off the question set. Residual: this q3 option, plus 'de sena utryckningarna' in q3 B, identifies the statutory duty as landowner-facing, which softly eliminates q2 B (a wage method, not a statutory duty) and q2 C (manning Nyhamn). A vs D stays undecided blind, and the elimination relies on assuming an unkeyed option's content is passage-true. Weak; routed to adjudication rather than passed.

findings.quote: Rensningsarbetet upphörde helt så snart årets flottning var avslutad.
findings.note: PARTIALLY. The stem's own term 'efterrensningen' presupposes clearing that continues after the season, so C ('upphorde helt sa snart arets flottning var avslutad') self-eliminates against the stem without the passage. B overreaches ('utan vidare rakna hem kostnaden') and D drifts to an income comparison, leaving A as the hedged on-topic option (blind pick A). Beats chance materially; not a pure-form leak of the key, so flag not kill.

findings.quote: Bemannade skolbibliotek ökade både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet på samtliga stadier i de fyra kommunerna.
findings.note: PARTIALLY. D overclaims on form (universal 'samtliga stadier' plus a causal 'okade bade ... och ...') and B denies any teaching-practice difference, so both fall blind. A and C are exact causal mirrors of one association (librarian -> source criticism vs source criticism -> librarian), so the key is visibly one of that pair, but the direction is not decidable without the passage (lean C). Mirror-pair distractors are legitimate design; flag, not kill.
